Property Partners McDonnell are delighted to present this exceptional A3-rated, 4 Bedroom Detached Residence, set on approximately 2.3 acres in the highly desirable rural setting of Turin, Bracklyn, Co. Westmeath. Offering approximately c.214 m2 of beautifully presented family accommodation, this impressive property provides an outstanding combination of modern comfort, energy efficiency, privacy and extensive ancillary facilities.
The heart of the home is the magnificent open-plan kitchen/dining area, featuring a bespoke fitted kitchen with nero graphite worktops, an impressive red AGA, integrated appliances, large breakfast island and excellent storage. Multiple picture windows and extensive patio doors flood the space with natural light while creating a wonderful connection with the private rear gardens and outdoor entertaining areas.
The ground floor also provides two generous reception rooms, a utility room and bathroom, while upstairs are 4 excellent double bedrooms, including a superb master bedroom with fitted wardrobes, ensuite and access to a large private balcony. A further ensuite, Jack & Jill arrangement and luxurious family bathroom provide exceptional convenience for modern family living.
Outside, the property continues to impress with electric gated entrances, extensive parking, a large concrete yard, outdoor lighting, car charging point, substantial decking area and a gazebo.
A particular feature is the extensive range of detached buildings. The large double garage incorporates a superb games/pool room and fully fitted bar, together with an additional home office. There is also a separate modern office building, complete with reception area, open-plan workspace, meeting area, kitchen and dedicated bathroom facilities, making it ideal for home-based business or professional use. A separate fully equipped gym with its own WC further enhances the property's versatility.
With its exceptional accommodation, outstanding energy efficiency, substantial private grounds and unrivalled range of ancillary facilities, this is a truly unique family home offering an enviable country lifestyle with excellent scope for both family and professional use.

Ideally positioned in the scenic rural setting of Fennor, Collinstown, Co. Westmeath, this residence offers the perfect balance of peaceful countryside living and convenient access to local amenities.
Collinstown village is just a short distance away, providing a shop, primary school, church, crèche, playground and a range of community and sporting facilities. Castlepollard is less than 10 minutes by car, while Mullingar is also readily accessible, offering an extensive range of shopping, educational, employment, sporting and transport facilities.

The surrounding countryside is renowned for its natural beauty, with Lough Lene, Fore Abbey, Tullynally Castle and Mullaghmeen Forest all within easy reach.
An appealing location combining rural tranquillity, excellent amenities and accessibility, making it an ideal setting for family living.
Turin GAA playing pitch:  almost opposite with playing pitch, grounds, walking track, Astroturf play area, ball walls and clubhouse 1 minute
